survivors.title: Bellows Bench
survivors.pitch: The phone becomes the tool — the machine plate unlocks the exact manual page for jewelry workshops: piece tracking minutes after the work happens, auto-makes a 30-second recap the owner will repost.

verdicts.attack: Voice transcription may struggle with workshop noise and technical jargon
verdicts.why: Creative use of phone as tool for jewelry workshops creates concrete value through automated documentation

verdicts.attack: Generic maintenance solution with unclear differentiation from existing CMMS systems
verdicts.why: Too similar to existing products, lacks unique value proposition
